block.title: Zone D enemies: wisp stream pouring from a cone crater as the fighter threads the cave road
block.positive: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired concept rendering, bold dark outlines, saturated limited palette, ultrawide panoramic arcade composition, subtle CRT scanline glow. A horizontal magma cave road inside a fortress-world's burning depths, the frame stretched wide like a scroll of danger: ceiling of jagged basalt drips with cooling slag, floor is a slow lava river glowing from dark ember red to tangerine, brick-like rock strata bands in rust brown breaking up the walls. On the left edge a sleek steel-blue dart fighter with cyan canopy streaks in, orange engine flare stretched long, banking between columns of stone. The right two-thirds belong to the IRON TIDE: a row of three MAGMA CONES of graduated size mounted along the cave floor like a gun battery, craters tilted up, each spewing a rising column of flame that breaks into a stream of EMBER WISPS — darting molten-gold hearts wrapped in ragged orange flame tongues with sparking tails — flowing left toward the fighter like a released swarm. Pink and red round shots with bright cores dot the columns, one cone mid-reload with its rock plates glowing cherry at the seams, a small orange-white blast chipping the ceiling where a wisp detonated. Deep-navy pockets in the far tunnels, never pure black.
block.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, watermark, blurry, pure black background, human figures, cartoon mascot, soft pastel palette, duplicate fighter, extra player ships, lens flare
block.notes: The panoramic band suits Zone D's scroll rhythm — cones read as terrain artillery, wisps as the mobile threat pouring off them. Keep exactly one fighter (anti-duplication guard in negative). Slag drip + strata bands give the wide frame vertical texture without stealing the lane.
